name: 图像谱系分析
description: Tracks the 篡改 history and ancestry of images through transformation chain 分析.
algorithm: Image Phylogeny Tree Reconstruction via Pairwise Dissimilarity
mechanism: Estimates the transformation history of an image 通过分析 degradation 模式. Each edit operation leaves cumulative traces that can be ordered into a phylogeny tree.
parameters: Dissimilarity: SSIM-based, Tree: minimum spanning, Features: 压缩伪影, Transform: chain
source: Dias, Z. et al. (2012) — Image Phylogeny by Minimal Spanning Trees, IEEE TIFS
useCase: 重建可能被篡改的图像的编辑历史

references.title: Dias, Z. et al. (2012) — Image Phylogeny by Minimal Spanning Trees, IEEE TIFS

strengths:
• Reveals 篡改 chain
• Estimates editing order
• Works with multiple transformations
• Useful for provenance tracking
limitations:
• Requires multiple image versions
• Cannot detect single-step edits
• Tree reconstruction may be ambiguous
• 计算密集 pairwise comparison
